Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax exemptions for fuel used by farmers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax exemptions for fuel used by farmers;amending RCW 82.08.0255 and 82.12.0256; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.08.0255 and 2005 c 443 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 shall not apply to sales of: (a) Dyed special fuel used by a farmer in the process of producingagricultural products, as these terms are defined in RCW 82.04.213; and (b) Motor vehicle and special fuel if: (((a))) (i) The fuel is purchased for the purpose of publictransportation and the purchaser is entitled to a refund or anexemption under RCW 82.36.275 or 82.38.080(3); or (((b))) (ii) The fuel is purchased by a private, nonprofittransportation provider certified under chapter 81.66 RCW and thepurchaser is entitled to a refund or an exemption under RCW 82.36.285or 82.38.080(1)(h); or (((c))) (iii) The fuel is taxable under chapter 82.36 or 82.38 RCW. p. 1 SB 6393 (2) Any person who has paid the tax imposed by RCW 82.08.020 on thesale of special fuel delivered in this state shall be entitled to acredit or refund of such tax with respect to fuel subsequentlyestablished to have been actually transported and used outside thisstate by persons engaged in interstate commerce. The tax shall beclaimed as a credit or refunded through the tax reports required underRCW 82.38.150.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.12.0256 and 2005 c 443 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter shall not apply in respect to theuse of: (1)(a) Special fuel purchased in this state upon which a refund isobtained as provided in RCW 82.38.180(2); and (b) Dyed special fuel used by a farmer in the process of producingagricultural products, as these terms are defined in RCW 82.04.213; and (2) Motor vehicle and special fuel if: (a) The fuel is used for the purpose of public transportation andthe purchaser is entitled to a refund or an exemption under RCW82.36.275 or 82.38.080(3); or (b) The fuel is purchased by a private, nonprofit transportationprovider certified under chapter 81.66 RCW and the purchaser isentitled to a refund or an exemption under RCW 82.36.285 or82.38.080(1)(h); or (c) The fuel is taxable under chapter 82.36 or 82.38 RCW:PROVIDED, That the use of motor vehicle and special fuel upon which arefund of the applicable fuel tax is obtained shall not be exempt underthis subsection (2)(c), and the director of licensing shall deduct fromthe amount of such tax to be refunded the amount of tax due under thischapter and remit the same each month to the department of revenue.
